name: BC Conservation Fund, Stream 1: Area Based Conservation Initiatives
summary: Grants for non-profits and community contribution companies in British Columbia building community mandate, planning and long-term stewardship and restoration of new conservation areas, with priority for First Nations. Expression of interest first.

amount.note: Phase 1 community initiatives tend to range up to $100K; more complex multi-year projects up to $250K.

reporting: Quarterly check-in calls, annual reports covering progress on deliverables and finances, and an end-of-project report.

calls.label: Expressions of interest (rolling)
calls.note: Expressions of interest are reviewed in two intakes a year; approved ones are invited to submit a full proposal.

status.quote: Stream 1 EOI Submissions are always open.

applicant_types.quote: Grants are open to any non-profit organization or community contribution company (C3) working on conservation or land/water use issues in BC. This includes Qualified and Non-Qualified Donee's. For BC Conservation Fund purposes, qualified donees may include: • First Nations • Charities and societies • Non-government organization (NGOs) • Universities and colleges

geography.quote: The BC Conservation Fund is a fund that supports the conservation of biodiverse land and freshwater areas in BC.

access.quote: Before being invited to complete a full funding application for review, an expression of interest must be completed and reviewed by the BC Conservation Fund.

window.quote: Stream 1 EOI Submissions are always open.

amount.quote: We anticipate that for smaller, more community-based initiatives in phase 1, grants will tend to range up to $100K, while more complex, multi-year projects will likely range up to $250K.
